mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS trend falls below 0.05 in any 3-year rolling window, or average 20-day returns during declining FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points from the prior month signals labor market deterioration that triggers immediate equity selling pressure, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 5-day returns following UNRATE rise > 0.3pp exceed -0.5% in more than 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC for threshold signal is below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPIAUCSL above 3.0% and FEDFUNDS above 4.0% indicates persistent inflation with restrictive policy, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction signal fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of triggered instances, or interaction term coefficient is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a decline in industrial production below 104.0 indicates manufacturing weakness that precedes earnings deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 20-day returns during late-cycle expansion with INDPRO < 104.0 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05), or signal fails to outperform market in >40% of periods.

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts trend over the past 6 months signals sustained consumer confidence and economic expansion, supporting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: Rank IC for HOUST trend falls below 0.04 in any 3-year rolling window, or average 5-day returns during rising HOUST periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate above 4.0% for two consecutive months signals restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 60-day returns following FEDFUNDS > 4.0% exceed -1.0% in more than 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC for threshold signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in payroll employment below 145,000 and industrial production below 104.0 indicates broad economic weakness that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction signal fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of triggered instances, or interaction term coefficient is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In post-labor market shock regimes, a rapid unemployment rate decline below 4.0% within one month signals labor market overheating that prompts aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 5-day returns during post-labor shock periods with UNRATE decline below 4.0% are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05), or signal fails to outperform market in >40% of periods.
